description_en: Adds a self-managed HDFS address to Xpack
description_zh: 在Xpack里增加用户自建的hdfs地址
name: AddUserHdfsInfo

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
dfs.nameservices specifies the nameservices name of DFS. dfs.ha.namenodes specifies the DFS nodes, such as nn1 and nn2.
dfs.namenode.http-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn1 specifies the port 50070 connection of HDFS nn1.
dfs.namenode.http-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn2 specifies the port 50070 connection of HDFS nn2.
dfs.namenode.rpc-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn1 specifies the port 8020 connection of HDFS nn1.
dfs.namenode.rpc-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn2 specifies the port 8020 connection of HDFS nn2.
Port 50070 connections and port 8020 connections exist on each HDFS node. The number of port 50070 and port 8020 connection pairs equals the number of HDFS nodes
parameters.help_zh:
dfs.nameservices为dfs的nameservices名称，dfs.ha.namenodes为dfs节点，如nn1，nn2。
dfs.namenode.http-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn1 为hdfs nn1的50070链接。
dfs.namenode.http-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn2 为hdfs nn2的50070链接。
dfs.namenode.rpc-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn1 为hdfs nn1的8020链接。
dfs.namenode.rpc-address.{dfs.nameservices}.nn2 为hdfs nn2的8020链接。
50070端口链接和8020端口链接在hdfs各个节点都存在，hdfs有几个节点，就有几对50070和8020端口的链接
parameters.name: ext_info

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
